name: Yuikawa Akari
source:
A modern day University student. 20 years old.
Summoned to "Ryugu" by the God of Spacetime, Ryujin
to become its priestess.
She is heavily empathetic, but slightly anxious.
From time to time, she will reveal a look of absent-mindedness.

[Translated from [url=http://www.gamecity.ne.jp/haruka-ryugu/characters/]official website[/url]]
